answer:
Key research papers on multi-agent orchestration, grouped by focus:

### Surveys and Taxonomies
* [Large Language Model based Multi-Agents: A Survey of Progress and Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.01680) (Guo et al., 2024, IJCAI). Foundational survey categorizing agent profiling, multi-agent communication environments, and skill growth mechanisms.
* [Multi-Agent Collaboration Mechanisms: A Survey of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06322) (Tran et al., 2025). Presents a five-dimensional orchestration taxonomy: actors, interaction types (cooperation, competition, coopetition), structures (peer-to-peer, centralized, distributed), strategies (role-based, model-based), and coordination protocols.
* [A survey on LLM-based multi-agent systems: workflow, infrastructure, and challenges](https://doi.org/10.1007/s44336-024-00009-2) (Li et al., 2024, *Vicinagearth*). Categorizes orchestration infrastructure and workflows across five components: profile, perception, self-action, mutual interaction, and evolution.
* [LLM-Based Multi-Agent Orchestration: A Survey of Frameworks, Communication Protocols, and Emerging Patterns](https://doi.org/10.3390/fi18060326) (Zhu et al., 2026, *Future Internet*). Focuses on structural coordination topologies: centralized, decentralized, and hierarchical, paired with dynamic-adaptive control axes.

### Foundational Architectures and Coordination Patterns
* [MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/MetaGPT%3A-Meta-Programming-for-A-Multi-Agent-Hong-Zhuge/792fd55d79d120173e0a944ce6bfe4787239c1d2) (Hong et al., 2023, ICLR). Uses an assembly-line topology encoding human Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) into structured artifact-passing protocols to reduce hallucination cascades.
* [AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/AutoGen%3A-Enabling-Next-Gen-LLM-Applications-via-Wu-Bansal/9ea0757c750ab1222a7442d3485a74d1c526b04c) (Wu et al., 2023). Implements generalized conversable agent topologies supporting pairwise chats, centralized manager hubs, and custom interaction graphs.
* [ChatDev: Communicative Agents for Software Development](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/ChatDev%3A-Communicative-Agents-for-Software-Qian-Liu/9474b463654fd92a62c103b21f95aed94b087907) (Qian et al., 2023, ACL). Introduces multi-phase sequential waterfall orchestration using bilateral (dyadic) peer-to-peer chat rounds.
* [CAMEL: Communicative Agents for "Mind" Exploration of Large Language Model Society](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/CAMEL%3A-Communicative-Agents-for-%22Mind%22-Exploration-Li-Hammoud/7bf72a3b5fbac8bc0f461780810fbc781c28ef53) (Li et al., 2023, NeurIPS). Establishes autonomous role-playing dyads coordinated via inception prompting without human intervention.
* [OSC: Cognitive Orchestration through Dynamic Knowledge Alignment in Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/OSC%3A-Cognitive-Orchestration-through-Dynamic-in-LLM-Zhang-Fan/ed131ad898f1e9ef0b420e4d3f605abfe055b5f3) (Zhang et al., 2025, EMNLP). Uses dynamic alignment networks and adaptive cognitive routing to coordinate agents dynamically rather than via static pipelines.

### Benchmarks, Evaluation, and Failure Analysis
* [Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Architectures for Financial Document Processing: A Comparative Study of Orchestration Patterns, Cost-Accuracy Tradeoffs and Production Scaling Strategies](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.22651.pdf) (Kulkarni & Kulkarni, 2026). Evaluates sequential pipeline, parallel fan-out, hierarchical supervisor-worker, and reflexive loop topologies, finding supervisor and reflexive loops offer superior error mitigation at higher communication cost.
* [Solving Multi-agent Path Finding as an LLM Benchmark: How, How Good and Why](https://openreview.net/forum?id=8hAxEFRVQT) (Chen et al., 2025). Adapts multi-agent path finding (MAPF) into an LLM benchmark for spatial coordination and collision avoidance.
* [Benchmark Self-Evolving: A Multi-Agent Framework for Dynamic LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.11443.pdf) (Wang et al., 2024). Multi-agent workflow generating and updating evaluation test suites to avoid static benchmark saturation.
* [SoK: When Safe Agents Fail Together: The Security of Multi Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00595.pdf) (Yang et al., 2026). Systematizes failure analysis across 197 multi-agent pipelines using an Adversary-Interface-Risk (A-I-R) framework, showing emergent collective vulnerabilities in individually safe agents.
* [Adversarial Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines: Unveiling Structural Vulnerabilities in Agentic AI Architectures](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/Adversarial-Attacks-in-Multi-Agent-LLM-Pipelines%3A-Bappy-Hossain/821025dd4e89d9fb61cc6ae08591bb47caa14abc) (Bappy et al., 2026). Identifies boundary verification failures across inter-agent interfaces (identity, state, intent, content) as the primary cause of pipeline breakdown.
* [AgentLeak: A Full-Stack Benchmark for Privacy Leakage in Multi-Agent LLM Systems](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2602.11510) (EL Yagoubi et al., 2026). Evaluates coordinator-worker failure modes, showing information leakage propagates predominantly over internal inter-agent channels rather than external outputs.

---

### Limitations and Uncovered Areas
* **Search engine blocks:** Google Scholar blocked automated queries with bot verification prompts, limiting search results to Semantic Scholar and arXiv. Papers With Code queries redirected to generic trending feeds.
* **Missing architectures:** Specific dynamic routing frameworks (e.g., Dynamic LLM-Agent Network / DyLAN) were not retrieved before search limits were hit.
* **Extraction depth:** Full-text evaluation tables, exact benchmark scoreboards, and framework comparison matrices from the Springer survey and benchmark PDFs were not extracted due to browser action limits.

foundational_architectures.findings:
### Findings
- [MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/MetaGPT%3A-Meta-Programming-for-A-Multi-Agent-Hong-Zhuge/792fd55d79d120173e0a944ce6bfe4787239c1d2) | **Authors:** Si-Rui Hong, Ming-Chen Zhuge, Xia-Wu Zheng, Chenglin Wu, Jurgen Schmidhuber, et al. | **Year:** 2023 (ICLR) | **System Name:** MetaGPT | **Coordination Topology:** Workflow-driven assembly line / role-based pipeline with structured communication protocols (SOPs) | **Primary Contribution:** Encodes human standard operating procedures (SOPs) as meta-programming prompts and structured document artifacts across specialized agents to prevent hallucination cascades and coordinate complex software development workflows | **Evidence:** Paper summary states it "incorporates efficient human workflows as a meta programming approach into LLM-based multi-agent collaboration and leverages the assembly line paradigm to assign diverse roles to various agents" (2,595+ citations) | **Relevance:** Foundational multi-agent framework defining role specialization and structured artifact-passing workflow topologies.

- [AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/AutoGen%3A-Enabling-Next-Gen-LLM-Applications-via-Wu-Bansal/9ea0757c750ab1222a7442d3485a74d1c526b04c) | **Authors:** Qingyun Wu, Gagan Bansal, Chi Wang, et al. | **Year:** 2023 | **System Name:** AutoGen | **Coordination Topology:** Conversable agent topology supporting pairwise, group chat (hub-and-spoke manager), and customizable flexible interaction graphs | **Primary Contribution:** Generic conversational multi-agent abstraction where agents are conversable, customizable, and capable of seamless human-in-the-loop interaction, simplifying execution of complex multi-agent workflows into modular chat rounds | **Evidence:** Page notes it "enables development of LLM applications using multiple agents that can converse with each other to solve tasks, which simplifies and unifies the implementation of complex LLM workflows as automated agent chats" (2,873+ citations) | **Relevance:** Foundational architecture establishing conversational primitives as the generalized control mechanism for multi-agent LLM orchestration.

- [ChatDev: Communicative Agents for Software Development](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/ChatDev%3A-Communicative-Agents-for-Software-Qian-Liu/9474b463654fd92a62c103b21f95aed94b087907) | **Authors:** Cheng Qian, Wei Liu, Maosong Sun, et al. | **Year:** 2023 (ACL) | **System Name:** ChatDev | **Coordination Topology:** Sequential waterfall/stage-gate multi-phase topology composed of atomic bilateral (dyadic) peer chats | **Primary Contribution:** Deconstructs multi-agent workflows into distinct software development phases (designing, coding, testing, documenting) executed via paired conversational role-playing (e.g., instructor-assistant) to solve subtasks autonomously | **Evidence:** Paper states ChatDev is "a chat-powered software development framework in which specialized agents driven by large language models (LLMs) are guided in what to communicate and how to communicate, establishing language as a unifying bridge" (1,309+ citations) | **Relevance:** Foundational system demonstrating staged peer-to-peer conversational orchestration for structured multi-step task execution.

- [CAMEL: Communicative Agents for "Mind" Exploration of Large Language Model Society](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/CAMEL%3A-Communicative-Agents-for-%22Mind%22-Exploration-Li-Hammoud/7bf72a3b5fbac8bc0f461780810fbc781c28ef53) | **Authors:** Guohao Li, Hasan Abed Al Kader Hammoud, Hani Itani, Dmitrii Khizbullin, Bernard Ghanem | **Year:** 2023 (NeurIPS) | **System Name:** CAMEL | **Coordination Topology:** Bilateral peer-to-peer / role-playing dyad guided by inception prompts | **Primary Contribution:** Introduces cooperative role-playing communication architectures where an AI user agent and an AI assistant agent converse autonomously via inception prompting to achieve goals without human intervention | **Evidence:** Record highlights a "novel communicative agent framework named role-playing, using inception prompting to guide chat agents toward task completion while maintaining consistency with human intentions" (1,998+ citations) | **Relevance:** Pioneer foundational paper establishing autonomous agent-to-agent prompt negotiation and communicative role assignment.

- [OSC: Cognitive Orchestration through Dynamic Knowledge Alignment in Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/OSC%3A-Cognitive-Orchestration-through-Dynamic-in-LLM-Zhang-Fan/ed131ad898f1e9ef0b420e4d3f605abfe055b5f3) | **Authors:** Jusheng Zhang, Yi-Jia Fan, Kaitong Cai, Xiaofei Sun, Ke-Ze Wang | **Year:** 2025 (EMNLP) | **System Name:** OSC (Cognitive Orchestration) | **Coordination Topology:** Dynamic alignment network / adaptive cognitive routing | **Primary Contribution:** Implements cognitive orchestration and dynamic knowledge alignment to dynamically transform parallel uncoordinated agents into collaborative teams, optimizing routing and inter-agent communication overhead | **Evidence:** Evaluated in EMNLP 2025; record demonstrates that "OSC significantly improves task performance and communication efficiency, transforming parallel-working individuals into a deeply collaborative cognitive team" (40 citations) | **Relevance:** Addresses dynamic routing and adaptive coordination topology beyond static pipelines.

### Coverage
- **Sites Searched:** Semantic Scholar (`semanticscholar.org`).
- **Queries Executed:**
  - `multi-agent orchestration framework LLM`
  - `MetaGPT multi-agent meta programming`
  - `AutoGen Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation`
  - `ChatDev Communicative Agents for Software Development`
  - `CAMEL Communicative Agents for Mind Exploration of Large Scale Language Model Society`
  - `dynamic LLM-agent network routing topology`
- **Volume Reviewed:** ~50 results across returned query listings.

### Limitations
- The 10 browser action execution limit prevented navigating arXiv and Papers With Code directly to extract additional dynamic graph routing architectures (e.g., DyLAN / Dynamic LLM-Agent Network).
- Citation counts reflect numbers recorded live on Semantic Scholar at time of retrieval.
